trans-unit.source: Hey, <Chester>. What do you plan to do after we're done here and go back home?
trans-unit.target: Hey, <Chester>. What do you plan to do after we're done here and go back home?

trans-unit.source: Just go back to everyday life.
trans-unit.target: Just go back to everyday life.

trans-unit.source: No way. It's just, no matter what's happened, I want to be the same guy I've always been.

trans-unit.source: Don't say her name. I never said it wouldn't be lonely, but...just let me do my own thing.
